title: A Monsoon for the Current
premise: Mara Reyes, a salvage diver haunted by the disappearance of his brother's expedition twelve years ago, is hired by a rival fleet to recover a navy-sealed wreck upriver before the glacier calving season opens—and closes—the only navigable route. As he dives deeper, he discovers the wreck holds his brother's final log and evidence that the navy's silence was bought with lives. Racing six tides against the salvage fleet and the melting ice, Mara must choose between loyalty to the men who raised him and the truth that could destroy them. In the end, he surfaces with the log, lets the flood take the wreck forever, and chooses truth over inheritance.
about_author: Ansel Amberdale is a former river pilot who spent a decade charting glacial waterways before turning to fiction. He writes from a houseboat on the northern coast, where he claims the tides still keep his schedule.

chapters.title: Twelve Years of Miles
chapters.summary: Mara Reyes dives a routine salvage off the coast, measuring his life in miles traveled rather than years lived. A navy notice forbids approach to an upriver wreck. POV: Mara. Emotional beat: restless numbness cracked by an old wound.

chapters.title: The Fleet's Offer
chapters.summary: Vessna Kade, captain of the rival salvage fleet, offers Mara triple pay to reach the wreck before her competitors—six tides before calving season opens the route. POV: Mara. Emotional beat: temptation wrapped in suspicion.

chapters.title: Radio Silence
chapters.summary: An upriver survey team stops answering the radio; among their last transmissions is a voice Mara recognizes from his brother's old crew. POV: Mara and dispatcher Ilo Venn. Emotional beat: dread reawakening grief he thought was buried.

chapters.title: Upriver
chapters.summary: Mara joins a small expedition boat pushing into the narrowing gorge, past warning buoys the navy never maintained. POV: Mara. Emotional beat: the river feels like returning to a grave.

chapters.title: What the Ice Keeps
chapters.summary: First dive on the wreck's outer hull reveals modern salvage cuts—someone got here first, years ago. POV: Mara. Emotional beat: cold shock; this isn't just a navy secret.

chapters.title: The First Tide
chapters.summary: Tide one spent mapping; Kade's fleet appears downstream, forcing a decision to hide the entry point. POV: Mara and deckhand Suri. Emotional beat: paranoia tightening into resolve.

chapters.title: A Voice in the Log
chapters.summary: Inside the flooded hold, Mara finds a waterproof logbook—his brother's handwriting, dated after the official death date. POV: Mara. Emotional beat: vertigo of hope and betrayal entwined.

chapters.title: Second Tide, Rising Cost
chapters.summary: A diver from Kade's fleet drowns in the wreck's collapsed corridor; Kade blames Mara's secrecy. POV: Kade. Emotional beat: guilt weaponized.

chapters.title: The Navy's Boat
chapters.summary: A gray patrol vessel anchors downstream, broadcasting orders to withdraw. The expedition goes dark to avoid it. POV: Ilo Venn. Emotional beat: fear of being erased like the others.

chapters.title: Third Tide: The Brother's Chamber
chapters.summary: Mara reaches a sealed cabin and recovers documents showing the navy sold the wreck's cargo and let the original crew drown to bury it. POV: Mara. Emotional beat: rage crystallizing into purpose.

chapters.title: Loyalty's Ledger
chapters.summary: Old mentor Doss Harrow, who raised Mara in the trade, arrives with Kade's fleet—he's been feeding them information for years. POV: Doss. Emotional beat: love corroded by debt and habit.

chapters.title: Fourth Tide: Confrontation at Anchor
chapters.summary: Kade and Mara strike a fragile truce: share the find, split the truth. Doss quietly signals the navy patrol. POV: Mara and Kade. Emotional beat: wary alliance, trust on a knife's edge.

chapters.title: The Glacier Groans
chapters.summary: Calving season begins early; ice groans upstream and the window starts closing faster than planned. POV: Suri. Emotional beat: nature indifferent to human schemes.

chapters.title: Fifth Tide: The Descent
chapters.summary: Mara makes his deepest dive for the final log pages through shifting wreckage as currents turn violent. POV: Mara. Emotional beat: claustrophobic courage, near-drowning.

chapters.title: Betrayal Surfacing
chapters.summary: The navy boards the expedition boat; Doss's tip led them there. Crew scattered or detained; the log nearly seized. POV: Ilo Venn. Emotional beat: bitter confirmation of every suspicion.

chapters.title: Sixth Tide
chapters.summary: Last tide before the route closes. Mara, Kade, and Suri make one final run to the wreck while the navy searches the wrong channel. POV: Mara. Emotional beat: desperate clarity—this is the last chance for truth.

chapters.title: Doss at the Waterline
chapters.summary: Doss intercepts them at the wreck, gun drawn, torn between the man he helped raise and the men who own him. POV: Doss. Emotional beat: the theme made flesh—loyalty versus truth.

chapters.title: Calving
chapters.summary: The glacier calves; the flood surge begins. Doss, choosing Mara at last, holds the navy boarding line long enough for the divers to surface—and is lost to the water. POV: Mara. Emotional beat: devastating cost of a late-arriving choice.

chapters.title: What the River Takes
chapters.summary: The surge collapses the wreck beyond recovery forever. Mara surfaces holding only the logbook pressed to his chest. POV: Mara. Emotional beat: grief and release in one breath.

chapters.title: Downriver
chapters.summary: The survivors run the rapids ahead of the closing ice, pursued briefly then abandoned by the retreating patrol. POV: Kade. Emotional beat: exhausted, changed camaraderie.

chapters.title: The Reading
chapters.summary: In a coastal tavern, Mara reads his brother's final entries aloud—to Kade, Suri, Ilo, and anyone who will listen. The truth leaves his hands and belongs to everyone now. POV: Mara. Emotional beat: mourning transmuted into testimony.

chapters.title: A Monsoon for the Current
chapters.summary: Seasons later, Mara dives again—not for salvage but to mark the drowned, including Doss. He measures life in tides now, and each one honestly kept. POV: Mara. Emotional beat: quiet peace; memory inherited, loyalty redeemed.
